string.name: about_fork_description
string.comment: %1$s is the address of AnkiDroid's source code, %2$s the list of its contributors

string.name: finished_title_later
string.comment: Finished screen title: nothing left right now, more later

string.name: finished_title_limit
string.comment: Finished screen title: a daily limit stopped the session

string.name: finished_title_done
string.comment: Finished screen title: nothing left until tomorrow

string.name: finished_next_day
string.comment: %s is a time of day, e.g. 4:00 AM, when the next day's Cards become available

resources.string: More cards will be ready tomorrow from %s.

string.name: finished_unbury
string.comment: Button on the finished screen which unburies Cards and returns to studying

string.name: finished_done
string.comment: Closes the finished screen at the end of a review session

plurals.name: deck_list_due_today
plurals.comment: The deck list's summary: new, learning and due Cards left today over every Deck

plurals.name: deck_list_studied_today
plurals.comment: Beside the deck list's summary: Cards answered today

string.name: deck_list_count_description
string.comment: A count on the deck list. %1$s is New, Learning or Due; %2$d the count

string.name: deck_list_nothing_due
string.comment: The deck list's summary when no Deck has a Card left to study today

string.name: deck_list_study_all
string.comment: Studies every Deck with cards left today

string.name: deck_list_empty_title
string.comment: Heading of the deck list when there are no Decks

string.name: deck_list_deck_actions
string.comment: Read by screen readers for a long press on a Deck in the deck list, which opens its menu

string.name: export_collection_replaces
string.comment: Under the collection package choices in the export dialog

resources.string: Importing a collection package replaces everything in the other app. If that app syncs with AnkiWeb, its next sync is a one-way upload that replaces what is on AnkiWeb.

string.name: export_deck_merges
string.comment: Under the deck package choices in the export dialog

resources.string: Importing a deck package merges into what is already in the other app. Nothing else there is replaced, and its next sync is a normal one.

string.name: update_later
string.comment: dismiss the update dialog until the next daily check

resources.string: Allow Hayaki to install apps, then tap Update again
